newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close shade lower in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close shade lower in mixed trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed marginally lower in mixed trade as mutual fund buying wiped off losses on foreign institutional selling, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 0.19 points lower at 692.39.
"Apart from buying by domestic financial institutions, a slowdown in selling by foreign investors also helped put a lid on the slide," said Vijay Aggarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Brokers said shares of ITC, currently under investigation for alleged foreign exchange law violations, were in the spotlight.
ITC, which had been falling for the past few sessions, recovered 7.60 rupees to 252.60 as speculators made purchases at the prevailing low prices, they said.
"The market is in an oversold position and share prices should recover in the coming weeks," said another broker.
Larsen and Toubro rose 3.75 rupees to 218.75 on mutual fund buying, they said.
TISCO rose 1.0 rupee to 168.0, while ACC gained 7.75 rupees to 1,418 on short covering by speculators, brokers said.
